# Tinct

Tinct is a deep-reading platform for public-domain classics. It offers free online reading, original texts, modern English editions, context-aware AI help, synced audio, notes, highlights, and spoiler-aware character guides.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://tinct.app/
- Library: https://tinct.app/read
- About: https://tinct.app/about
- Sitemap: https://tinct.app/sitemap.xml

## Representative Books

- The Odyssey: https://tinct.app/read/odyssey
- War and Peace: https://tinct.app/read/war-and-peace
- Crime and Punishment: https://tinct.app/read/crime-and-punishment
- Pride and Prejudice: https://tinct.app/read/pride-and-prejudice
- Hamlet: https://tinct.app/read/hamlet
- The Republic: https://tinct.app/read/the-republic
- Meditations: https://tinct.app/read/meditations
- Jane Eyre: https://tinct.app/read/jane-eyre
- Frankenstein: https://tinct.app/read/frankenstein
- The Divine Comedy: https://tinct.app/read/divine-comedy

## Crawling Guidance

Use the public HTML pages for citations and summaries. Do not crawl `/data/`, `/api/`, `/audio/`, or app-internal assets for bulk extraction. The edition texts are public-domain-derived, but the product experience, alignment, metadata, and reading tools are the canonical Tinct surface.
